read.thesis: Carrier's CSA resi channel destocking is complete with field inventory down ~32% to 2018 levels, but 2026 guidance is only flat to low-mid single digit organic growth, with resi sales down high single digits and Q1 organic down high single digits.

utilisation.quote: which had less than half the output compared to Q4 of last year

triggers.label: Field inventory down ~32% YoY
triggers.quote: ending January down about 32% year over year, now at 2018 levels

triggers.label: Resi plant output less than half of Q4 LY
triggers.quote: significant under absorption in our resi manufacturing facilities, which had less than half the output compared to Q4 of last year

triggers.label: Data center orders up 5x in Q4
triggers.quote: CSA data center orders up more than five times

triggers.label: 2026 organic growth ~flat to LSD-MSD
triggers.quote: We expect flat to low mid-single digit organic growth and reported sales of approximately $22 billion

guidance.quote: We expect flat to low mid-single digit organic growth and reported sales of approximately $22 billion
Total company adjusted operating profit is expected to be about $3.4 billion.
We expect adjusted EPS of approximately $2.8 up high single digits versus 2025.
We expect free cash flow to be approximately $2 billion which will be second half weighted
we intend to repurchase about $1.5 billion in shares
supporting data center revenue guidance of $1.5 billion for 2026
with organic revenue down high single digits, including CSA resi down over 20%

red_flags.label: Q4 decrementals 50% ex-FX, 2026 resi volume down high single digits
red_flags.quote: Our decrementals are 50%. Still really high.

red_flags.label: Q4 inventory build from kept-running US resi plants
red_flags.quote: is a couple 100,000,000 more inventory on our books at the end of the year than we otherwise would
